script_text: Pisces, the cosmos is about to crack open a door you thought was sealed. From Monday to Wednesday, the Sun in your 5th House of romance sextiles Mars in your 7th House of partnership, making Tuesday best for passion, while Saturn in your 2nd House of money sextiles Pluto in your 12th House, stabilizing career cash. On Thursday, Jupiter enters your 6th House of work, expanding duties and health focus. Late week, Venus in your 6th House trines Neptune, your ruling planet, in your 2nd House of resources, blending art with income, and Sunday’s full moon in your 11th House opposes the Sun, balancing social and intimate needs. Tuesday is your power day because the Sun-Mars sextile ignites love. Thursday is your worst day because Jupiter’s entrance overwhelms schedules. Weekly advice: harness your Water element by meditating near water before money talks. Follow for daily updates.
